Because the priority rule escalates on (active_condition Infective arthritis), any patient whose joint is warm, swollen, severely painful and stiff - including a long-standing polyarthritis flare that the page sends down the chronic arthritis path - is diagnosed probable septic arthritis and made Urgent. Adding (<= (onset ...) (time_ago N days)) on the pain and (snomed_concept "Monoarticular joint involvement" "finding") would restore the page's discriminators.

An injured patient with severe swelling or deformity gets probable sprain/strain alongside probable fracture; a patient matching septic arthritis also matches chronic or gonococcal arthritis if the other criteria line up.
